# VOUT Web · Personal Finance & Bi-Directional Cloud Hub
> Web companion and cloud synchronization engine for VOUT Mobile Expense Tracker.

## Overview
VOUT is a personal finance ecosystem built for disciplined budgeting, recurring subscription auditing, and real-time disposable income tracking ("Safe to Spend").

## System Capabilities
- Bi-directional sync between Next.js Web and React Native Mobile
- Isolated multi-user PostgreSQL storage on Neon Cloud (`vout` schema)
- Fixed bills, subscription cycle tracking, and micro-expense logging
- Offline-first mobile synchronization via `/api/sync` (Bearer token auth)

## Live URLs
- Web Hub: https://vout-web.vercel.app
- Mobile APK Download: https://github.com/AgustinMilesi/expenses/releases/latest/download/VOUT.apk
- Mobile Repository: https://github.com/AgustinMilesi/expenses
- Web Repository: https://github.com/AgustinMilesi/expenses-web

## Architecture
- Next.js 16 + React 19 + Turbopack + Tailwind CSS v4
- Prisma ORM 6 + Neon Serverless PostgreSQL
- Cyber-Lime (#C6F827) and Deep Obsidian (#0A0E14) UI token system
- Creator: Agustín Milesi (https://github.com/AgustinMilesi)
